name: Rough Quartz
summary: In Durotar, a shaman receives Rough Quartz from a Minor Manifestation of Earth. An elder binds the stone into the shaman’s first Earth Totem.

sections.title: Heart of the Earth Totem
sections.body:
In Durotar or Mulgore, a Minor Manifestation of Earth gives Rough Quartz to a shaman who communes with the spirits. To an untrained eye, the stone looks like an ordinary desert pebble. It represents endurance, patience, and unwavering strength.

At the Valley of Trials, Canaga Earthcaller binds the quartz into carved wood to make an Earth Totem. The stone becomes the spiritual focus that joins a young shaman to Azeroth’s living soil.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Rough Quartz?
aliases: why do i need rough quartz
faq.answer: An elder shaman binds Rough Quartz into an initiate’s first Earth Totem as its spiritual core. It also shows that the novice has communed with the elemental earth spirit.

faq.q: Who gives you the Rough Quartz?
aliases: where do i get rough quartz
faq.answer: A Minor Manifestation of Earth grants you Rough Quartz after you commune with the spirit during the Call of Earth ritual in Durotar or Mulgore.

faq.q: Who do I bring this stone to in Durotar?
aliases: where to turn in rough quartz
faq.answer: Bring Rough Quartz to Canaga Earthcaller, the shaman trainer in the Valley of Trials. Canaga fashions it into your Earth Totem.

faq.q: Is this quartz used for anything else?
aliases: is rough quartz used in crafting
faq.answer: No. Rough Quartz is a sacred ritual object used to make an Earth Totem. It has no use in common trade.

angles.text: As a shaman, Rough Quartz marks your first communion with the element of earth. It anchors your spells and marks your path as a conduit of the spirits.
